scripts: UPDATE district SET d_ytd = d_ytd + 0 WHERE d_w_id = 1 AND d_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10

hot_update_tpcc_district_lock.success_criteria: During and shortly after injection: Innodb_row_lock_waits increases by at least 50 and lock wait time by >=3s; and either Slow_queries increases by >=1 or p95 latency ratio >=1.5; and QPS drops to <=80% of baseline.
hot_update_tpcc_district_lock.risk_assessment: May cause transaction timeouts or deadlocks in TPCC workload; temporary QPS degradation expected; mitigated by 12s duration and per-session innodb_lock_wait_timeout=5; ROLLBACK ensures no persistent data changes.
